data.one_liner: Native drag and drop for Flutter across desktop, mobile and web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DragItemWidget and DropRegion that enable native drag‑and‑drop interactions. It supports custom data formats, virtual files and multi‑finger gestures on iOS.
use_when: Need to drag content between Flutter apps or to external apps
Require custom data formats or virtual file support
Want a single‑purpose widget for drag‑and‑drop
avoid_when: You need a lightweight plugin without Rust or NDK dependencies
You only need simple drag‑and‑drop on a single platform
strengths: Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Web)
Supports custom data formats and virtual files
weaknesses: Requires Rust toolchain and NDK for first build
Large binary size on some platforms
Web drag support limited to same tab
data.setup_notes: Install Rust (or let plugin download binaries). On Android, NDK will be auto‑installed; specify minSdkVersion 23. Add a content provider in AndroidManifest.xml if using custom data or super_clipboard.
